lines.text: Marked, and you came to me. Smart. Nobody in the Sink cares what colour your name is. Now what's it worth?
One of Ninety-Nine's. You know what your people cost me? I'll tell you the number. Then I'll tell you what you're going to cost them.
There's a record now, friend. That's something we can price. What was listening is another matter.
You recorded five points around the warm stack. The account names no candle keeper. Somebody still has to tend a candle.
Your power schedule names no terrace for that load. It routes below the Sink. A blank address still uses power.
The note in your cache blames Ninety-Nine for ledger week. It is dated last month. Keep the note; ask what supports it.
Three subscribers restrained, alive. The notice calls that collection. A notice can name a debt without proving who owes it.
Friend! Sit down, the car doesn't stop, that's the whole trick of it. What do you need and what's it worth to you?
A Wake. Day what? Doesn't matter. In the Sink you were a person the moment you could pay.

barks.text: Forty minutes round. I've done it eleven thousand times. I know every face on every terrace. That's the trouble with knowing.
